name: cure-res-lab-front
note: L10 R5 main laboratory (bld.cure-lab-main) entry side at the real game camera with a reused ambulance, a reused tent, the new generator and quarantine fence. Run with --matrix. Look for: glazed vestibule with canopy and posts on the ground, ribbon windows, roof plant on the roof, step, fence panels in a row, generator beside the entrance, sunk or floating parts, flicker, missing parts at the low tier (LOD2).
